title: The Rough Summit
author: Ansel Eriksen
blurb: Ivo Villalobos, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
